newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tuan Sing acquires sites for S$55.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Tuan Sing acquires sites for S$55.5 mln.

text.p: Diversified property company Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd said it has acquired two freehold residential sites for Singapore $55.55 million through a wholly-owned subsidiary.
It said the sites, with a total area of 9,366 sq m, had been acquired with the intention of redeveloping them into six units of good class bungalows of up to two storeys high.

The acquisition is not expected to have a material impact on net tangible assets and earnings for the year ending December 31, 1996 as completion of the purchase is scheduled to take place in February 1997.
